setting: A wet harbour town. Tonight Duke Aldric hosts a feast in his hall. His signet ring seals every tax writ in Greywater, and half the town wants it gone.
note: Player and GM lines are scripted. NPC lines are generated live by each NPC's own agent (voices: a hosted model).

*Raises his goblet high, the gold signet flashing like a small sun.* "To Greywater, and to those honest enough to fill my hall on a night such as this! Let no man here mistake my generosity for weakness. Drink, friends, and let us see who among you is worth trusting." *His gaze drifts slowly across the table, lingering a moment too long on the captain.*

*Lifts the hand slowly, letting the gold catch the light, and turns it toward her with a faint, satisfied smile.* Ah, you have an eye for fine things, Mistress Mira. Yes, this is the seal of Greywater, and every tax writ in this realm bears its impression. *He withdraws the hand a fraction, just out of reach.* Admire it from there. A ring of such weight is not handed about the table like a sugared plum, and I trust you understand why.

*leans in, glancing both ways down the alley and lowering my voice*

Lifted it during the toast, eh? Bold, Mira. Bold and a touch foolish, with the guards still spilling wine in there. Let me see it first. Real gold, proper seal, and I'll give you a fair price... fairer than the duke would, anyway. Ten silver marks, and I'll not ask where you got it.

*Strides back into the hall, face flushed, the empty finger clenched at my side.* "The ring was on my hand at the toast, and by the time I reached my study it was gone. Someone at this table was close enough to me tonight to take it. I will have an answer before the wine is cold." *My eyes sweep the table, lingering on the nearest faces.* "Captain Voss has been watching my hand all evening, and Tomas has been far too eager to draw my guards' attention. Speak, all of you. Who among you touched my chair?"
